content.title: Animated Stir-Fry Chain | Prep, Wok, Serving and Diner Reaction
content.summary: An adult night-cafe chef cuts vegetables, wok-cooks one batch, plates it and receives one diner's satisfied first-bite proof. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult chef, one workspace, one ingredient set, one cutting tool, one heated vessel, one plate and one adult diner remain bound. + Each beat performs one irreversible food-state operation and preserves visible material traces from the prior state. + Prepared ingredients enter the same heated vessel and cannot reset to whole raw form after cooking begins. + The plated food carried through the route is the same cooked batch proven in the wok. + The final adult tasting reaction occurs only after handoff and keeps the remaining dish visible as completion evidence.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original clearly adult animated night-cafe chef with a copper quiff, white jacket and teal neckerchief; lock one wooden prep bench, red pepper, yellow squash, oyster mushrooms, cleaver, iron wok, blue-rim plate and one adult diner in the adjoining room. Move all prepared pieces into the same iron wok, toss them twice through visible blue flame and stir until their surfaces become glossy and softened; do not restore any raw whole ingredient. Hand the same plate to the adult diner, show one restrained first bite and hold a warm satisfied smile with chef, diner and remaining dish all visible as the terminal proof.

The final adult tasting reaction occurs only after handoff and keeps the remaining dish visible as completion evidence.
